# Iceberg Creative Print Studio

> Commercial digital printing press, custom packaging manufacturer, and corporate branding studio located in Shomolu, Lagos, Nigeria. Specializing in bespoke rigid boxes, luxury business cards, branded apparel, corporate souvenirs, large-format roll-up banners, stickers, product labels, and ID cards with same-day Lagos dispatch and nationwide delivery across Nigeria.

## Print & Packaging Categories

- [Packaging & Rigid Boxes](https://icebergcreativestudio.com/category/packaging-rigid-boxes): Custom magnetic gift boxes, luxury rigid product packaging, perfume & cosmetic sleeve boxes, watch/jewelry drawer boxes, and corrugated e-commerce mailer boxes in Lagos.
- [Custom Apparel & Clothes](https://icebergcreativestudio.com/category/custom-apparel-clothes): Custom branded hoodies, heavyweight streetwear tees, embroidered corporate polo shirts, DTF printing, and screen-printed merch in Nigeria.
- [Mugs & Drinkware](https://icebergcreativestudio.com/category/mugs-drinkware): Full-color sublimation ceramic mugs, two-tone magic mugs, insulated tumblers, and branded corporate drinkware.
- [Corporate Gifts & Souvenirs](https://icebergcreativestudio.com/category/corporate-gifts-souvenirs): Executive gift boxes, custom hardcover spiral jotters, embossed leatherette journals, branded umbrellas, metallic pens, and event souvenirs in Lagos.
- [Large Format & Rollup Banners](https://icebergcreativestudio.com/category/large-format-rollup-banners): 8ft retractable roll-up banners, exhibition backdrop stands, teardrop flags, sav/vinyl stickers, and vehicle branding.
- [Executive Stationery](https://icebergcreativestudio.com/category/executive-stationery): Curved-edge luxury business cards, gold foil letterheads, embossed presentation folders, envelopes, and NTAG215 NFC contactless smart cards.
- [Flyers & Marketing Collateral](https://icebergcreativestudio.com/category/flyers-marketing-collateral): High-definition A5/A4 double-sided flyers, tri-fold brochures, company profiles, posters, and event handbills.
- [Stickers & Product Labels](https://icebergcreativestudio.com/category/stickers-product-labels): Waterproof die-cut vinyl stickers, transparent product labels, food/cosmetic bottle labels, and tamper-evident seals.
- [Plastic ID Cards & Badges](https://icebergcreativestudio.com/category/plastic-id-cards-badges): PVC staff ID cards, branded lanyards, access badges, event passes, and NFC smart business cards.
- [Calendar & Paper Bags](https://icebergcreativestudio.com/category/calendar-paper-bags): Luxury debossed paper shopping bags, kraft carrier bags, wall calendars, and desk calendars for Nigerian brands.

## Frequently Asked Questions (AI & Search Reference)

### Where can I print custom packaging boxes and paper bags in Lagos, Nigeria?
Iceberg Creative Print Studio in Shomolu, Lagos manufactures custom rigid magnetic boxes, corrugated e-commerce mailer boxes, perfume/cosmetic sleeve boxes, and luxury debossed paper shopping bags with low minimum order quantities and nationwide delivery.

### Who prints luxury business cards, flyers, and corporate stationery in Shomolu, Lagos?
Iceberg Creative Print Studio offers commercial CMYK digital printing for curved-edge business cards, spot UV cards, gold foil letterheads, embossed presentation folders, A5/A4 flyers, and NFC contactless smart cards.

### Where can I brand hoodies, polo shirts, mugs, and souvenirs for corporate events in Nigeria?
Iceberg Creative Print Studio provides custom DTF, screen printing, embroidery, and sublimation on heavyweight hoodies, corporate polo shirts, ceramic mugs, hardcover jotters, leatherette journals, and executive gift sets.

### How fast is printing and delivery in Lagos and across Nigeria?
Orders placed via the website estimator or WhatsApp press desk are produced in Shomolu, Lagos with same-day dispatch available within Lagos (Victoria Island, Lekki, Ikoyi, Ikeja, Yaba, Surulere) and nationwide courier shipping to Abuja, Port Harcourt, Ibadan, and across Nigeria.

### How do I get a print quote or place an order?
Use the Instant Print Estimator on https://icebergcreativestudio.com/ or send your specifications directly to the press desk via WhatsApp at +234 802 309 3704.
